components.name: Data App / browser
components.responsibility: Own application logic, including authorized reads from one provider and writes through another.
components.interfaces: Service session, native requests, ordinary capability invocation and optional explicit Jobs/live events.
components.invariant: App IDs are configuration and attribution, not package identity. Entrusted authenticators stay private; native provider-created credentials may be returned.
components.failure: Page closure does not revoke authority, disconnect providers or cancel started jobs; private reads require current verified authority.

components.name: API process
components.responsibility: Replicable HTTP role for native routing, ordinary provider capabilities, identity, connections and callbacks; optional Redis live delivery.
components.interfaces: Authenticated HTTP adapters and narrow domain contracts.
components.invariant: Ordinary capabilities share native request authority/transport and have no Job or saved payload. Explicit Jobs execute on the worker.
components.failure: Redis failure degrades live events only. Postgres readiness gates protected work; callbacks and native proxy do not depend on Redis.

components.name: Worker process
components.responsibility: Core session/handoff/mutation maintenance, plus enabled or outstanding Jobs and configured source hooks. Ordinary capabilities stay on the API.
components.interfaces: Bounded due scans and conditional transitions; Job claims/slots only for durable work, shared helper and optional source hooks.
components.invariant: Persist task identity before resumable observation. Live tokens, incarnations, leases and generations fence every outcome.
components.failure: Reserve control capacity. Cleanup deadline and external watchdog require confirmed process exit before reuse; interrupted siblings can have unknown outcomes without replay.
components.extension: Per-handler child isolation only if measured disruption warrants it.

components.name: Postgres
components.responsibility: Authoritative identity, sessions, credentials/context, Jobs/results, source state and coordination.
components.interfaces: Coherent read-only request projections, owner-specific mutation/background/disclosure transactions and bounded maintenance.
components.invariant: Usable ordinary routing has zero logical writes or policy shared-lock commit. Mutations retain fresh-time/revision/claim fences.
components.failure: Ordinary backup restore accepts lost changes since that backup.
components.extension: Extend owner-specific tables with versioned migrations.

components.name: Tableau identity
components.responsibility: Supported identity adapters verify configured deployment, site and stable authorizing user for Tableau Cloud and Tableau Server Data Apps.
components.interfaces: Separate published Cloud login plus backend site/user verification observed; actual Cloud and Server end-to-end adapters still need proof.
components.invariant: Verified Tableau authentication anchors a seven-day maximum; activity/access refresh cannot extend it. No promise of silent reauthentication.
components.failure: Silent restoration, account switching, media, long-term sessions and Server compatibility remain unverified. Published-viewer equality is not required.
components.extension: Add provider-supported identity mechanisms behind the shared identity adapter after deployment evidence.

components.name: Provider APIs
components.responsibility: Expose native API methods, responses and optional task/event interfaces.
components.interfaces: Approved destinations, shared authorization flows, native HTTP response streaming.
components.invariant: Entrusted authenticators stay private; intentionally returned native provider-created credentials are permitted. No automatic business replay.
components.failure: A transport failure does not prove absence of provider effects.
components.extension: Declarative registrations and reusable ordinary HTTP capabilities; Job entrypoints and source hooks only when chosen.

components.name: Authorized enrollment backend
components.responsibility: Maintain approved Tableau site registry entries through a narrow protected management adapter.
components.interfaces: Dedicated registry-only management credential; no ordinary viewer/provider credential interface.
components.invariant: Registry administration cannot read provider secrets, mint user authority or expand shared-connection audiences.
components.failure: Disabled site admission blocks new service authority; current authorization follows the explicit session and transaction contracts.
components.extension: The enrollment interface and administrator authentication are separately operated.

components.name: Redis Pub/Sub
components.interfaces: Publisher plus one subscriber per API replica; TLS and scoped channel ACLs.
components.invariant: No Redis client or deployment when events are disabled; no replay or raw-event storage.
components.failure: Outage loses native live events and Job hints; auth, native proxy, durable Jobs and task callbacks continue, as do ordinary capabilities.
components.extension: Tune measured byte buffers and reconnect backoff without a durable event subsystem.

components.name: External watchdog
components.responsibility: Observe worker progress outside its event loop and terminate a stuck process.
components.interfaces: Host liveness/progress signal and confirmed process-exit handshake.
components.invariant: Stop claims and confirm termination before reusing execution capacity.
components.failure: A restart can interrupt sibling handlers; preserve unknown outcomes and do not replay.
components.extension: Select a hosting mechanism only after the runtime proof.

summary.title: Native routing is the foundation
summary.label: Ordinary HTTP
summary.detail: Cloud and Server Data Apps use native requests and optional reusable provider code with the same authorization and transport. Useful payloads stream directly; no Job or saved result is implied.

summary.title: Durability is an explicit choice
summary.label: Optional Jobs
summary.detail: Choose a supported Job entrypoint for background/recoverable execution or retained outcomes. Only Jobs have 100 MB input/result caps, a 24-hour first-start deadline and seven/thirty-day retention.

summary.title: Read current authority once
summary.label: Usable-credential route
summary.detail: One coherent read-only request snapshot, zero logical writes and no per-call policy shared-lock commit. Core maintenance remains owned even when Jobs and source hooks are absent.

streamingSummary: Node byte streams preserve encoded provider bodies and compression headers with backpressure. Generic GET/HEAD-body POST and inspectable no-follow redirect carriers preserve native semantics. Physical buffers, headers, sockets and aggregate memory are measured and bounded; no arbitrary response-size cap. Job input/result caps are separate. Downloads and ordinary capability responses do not become Jobs because of size or streaming.
